parts.solution_md:

Total of white counters: 3 × 9 = 27

Mean = (46 + 27) ÷ 7 = **10.4** (3 s.f.)

parts.problem_md: A regular polygon has n sides. Each interior angle of the regular polygon is 135° greater than each exterior angle of the polygon. Find the value of n. n=
parts.solution_md:
Interior + exterior = 180°, and interior = exterior + 135°

So 2 × exterior = 45°, exterior = 45°

n = 360 ÷ 45 = **8**
